description: Read-only filesystem listing of a fixed set of user folders (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Home), plus opening a file/folder with the OS default handler — backs the Files dock panel. No write access from this surface; the existing chat-driven create-file/create-folder tool (apps/api) is a separate, already-scoped path. shell:allow-execute below is a fixed, named allowlist of read-only diagnostic commands (whoami, hostname, ipconfig, systeminfo, tasklist, netstat, ver) with no user-supplied arguments at all — backs the Terminal dock panel as a diagnostics tool, deliberately not arbitrary/free-text command execution. core:webview:allow-create-webview-window lets the main window (trusted, our own React code) open a new real browser window for the Browser dock panel — deliberately scoped to `windows: [main]` only, so that spawned browser window (which renders arbitrary third-party sites) is NOT itself granted any of these capabilities; it gets Tauri's default-deny. core:window:allow-get-all-windows and core:window:allow-close back the 'reuse one browser window' logic (look up the existing omnira-browser window by label, close it before opening the next URL) — neither takes a pre-configured scope in Tauri, but since only main and omnira-browser ever exist and the browser window itself has no capabilities, this only ever lets the trusted main window enumerate/close its own single spawned child.
